title: Orientation
description: How Telugu sounds, how this platform works, and a quick skill check.

units.title: Welcome
units.communicationGoal: Understand how Telugu works and where to start.
units.canDoStatement: I know what the course covers and where my starting point is.

title: The Telugu Script
description: Every letter, from అ to క్ష: vowels, consonants, vowel signs, and double letters.

units.title: First Letters
units.communicationGoal: Recognize your first Telugu letters inside real words.
units.canDoStatement: I can recognize అ, ఆ, ఇ, క and మ, and read అమ్మ.

units.title: Vowels · అచ్చులు
units.communicationGoal: Recognize every Telugu vowel by sight and sound.
units.canDoStatement: I can name all the Telugu vowels when I see or hear them.

units.title: Consonants · హల్లులు
units.communicationGoal: Recognize the Telugu consonants row by row.
units.canDoStatement: I can identify the consonants and tell hard (ట) from soft (త) sounds.

units.title: Vowel Signs · గుణింతాలు
units.communicationGoal: Read any consonant with any vowel sign.
units.canDoStatement: I can read syllables like కా, కి, మా, తో on sight.

units.title: Double Letters · వత్తులు
units.communicationGoal: Read doubled letters (vattulu) inside words.
units.canDoStatement: I can read words with doubles like అక్క and అమ్మ.

units.title: Reading Real Words
units.communicationGoal: Read real Telugu words without help.
units.canDoStatement: I can read familiar words (అమ్మ, పాలు, నమస్కారం) without transliteration.

title: First Conversations
description: Greetings, names, how are you, yes and no, and your family.

units.title: Saying Hello
units.communicationGoal: Greet an elder respectfully, introduce yourself, and ask how they are.
units.canDoStatement: I can greet someone respectfully, say my name, ask theirs, ask how they are, and say goodbye.
units.realWorldScenario: Meeting a relative or an elder at a family gathering.

units.title: Politeness & Family
units.communicationGoal: Answer politely and talk about your family.
units.canDoStatement: I can say yes and no politely and name the people in my family.

title: Building Blocks
description: Pronouns, my and your, is and there-is, the glue of every sentence.

units.title: The Glue Words
units.communicationGoal: Use the little words that glue every sentence together.
units.canDoStatement: I can point things out, say what is mine and yours, and say where people are.

title: Numbers & Counting
description: Count from one to one hundred.

units.title: Counting
units.communicationGoal: Count and use numbers in real requests.
units.canDoStatement: I can count to one hundred and ask for a number of things.

title: Everyday Needs
description: Food, asking for things, likes and dislikes, home, and colors.

units.title: Food & Wants
units.communicationGoal: Ask for food and drink and say what you like.
units.canDoStatement: I can ask for what I want at the table and say what I like or have had enough of.

units.title: Home & Colors
units.communicationGoal: Describe your home and the colors around you.
units.canDoStatement: I can name the rooms and things at home and the colors I see.

title: Days & Time
description: Days of the week, today and tomorrow, morning to night.

units.title: The Week
units.communicationGoal: Talk about the days of the week.
units.canDoStatement: I can say which day it is and name the whole week.

units.title: When?
units.communicationGoal: Place events in time.
units.canDoStatement: I can say today, tomorrow, yesterday, and the time of day.

title: The World Around You
description: Animals, your body, and the weather outside.

title: People & Places
description: Question words, places around town, and giving directions.

units.title: Asking Questions
units.communicationGoal: Ask the five essential questions.
units.canDoStatement: I can ask what, who, where, why and how.

units.title: Around Town
units.communicationGoal: Talk about places and where things are.
units.canDoStatement: I can name places in town and say if they are near, far, left or right.

title: Doing Words
description: First verbs, polite requests, and saying what you're doing.

units.title: Actions
units.communicationGoal: Use everyday verbs and make polite requests.
units.canDoStatement: I can use basic verbs, make respectful requests, and say what I am doing.

title: Making Sentences
description: Word order, plurals, questions, and your first past and future.

units.title: Sentence Craft
units.communicationGoal: Build your own correct Telugu sentences.
units.canDoStatement: I can build sentences with the verb last, make plurals, join ideas, ask yes/no questions, and use past and future.

title: Real Conversations
description: Speaking with grandparents, visiting homes, and daily life.

units.title: With Family Elders
units.communicationGoal: Hold a warm conversation with family elders.
units.canDoStatement: I can visit an elder, respond politely, and follow everyday family talk.
